title: Multiply-Accumulate
text: Perform a multiply-accumulate operation on the inputs, 6 inputs, 5 outputs, {Operation Mode} sets Mode of accumulation of inputs; {Bias} sets the offset to add to the input dot product, {Number of Samples} sets the number of samples of valid accumulated output, {Output data type} sets the data type of the block output, {Integer rounding mode} sets the rounding mode for fixed-point operations, {Valid output port} controls generation of validOut output port, {End input and output ports} controls generation of endIn input port and endOut output, {Start output port} controls generation of startOut output port and {Count output port} controls generation of countOut output port. Values come from the instance.

params.name: Operation Mode
params.values: Mode of accumulation of inputs ’Vector’ (default) | ’Streaming - using Start and End Ports’ | ’Streaming - using Number of Samples’

params.name: Bias
params.values: Offset to add to the input dot product {’0.0’} (default)

params.name: Number of Samples
params.values: Number of samples of valid accumulated output signal {’2’} (default)

params.name: Output data type
params.values: Data type of the block output Inherit: Inherit via back propagation (default)

params.name: Integer rounding mode
params.values: Rounding mode for fixed-point operations Floor (default) | Ceiling | Convergent | Nearest | Round | Simplest | Zero

params.name: Valid output port
params.values: Control generation of validOut output port off (default) | on

params.name: End input and output ports
params.values: Control generation of endIn input port and endOut output port off (default) | on

params.values: Control generation of startOut output port off (default) | on
